One-Person Company (OPC) AI Startup Trend Monitor: 5.7M Solo Founders, China’s Policy Bonanza, and the Rise of the “No-Human” Company

Generated: 2026-07-13 13:04 (Beijing Time) · Window: public signals from the past 7 days

TL;DR: The policy side is throwing money at solo founders like never before — Hainan’s provincial OPC policy is now live, and Shenzhen / Suzhou / Changzhou are piling on with compute vouchers and direct funds. On the supply side, individually-owned “one-person companies” in China have surged to nearly 5.7 million (up 42% YoY). On the demand side, real moneymaking cases have evolved from “$50K/month” to “one person, $401M/year.” The One-Person Company (OPC) has moved from buzzword to industrial deployment.

1. Key Signals This Week

  • Scale: Per Sesame Credit (Zhima), individually-credited “one-person companies” now approach 5.7 million, +42% YoY; tech promotion and software/information industries make up 17.9% of OPCs, showing deep binding with the digital economy.
  • Policy: Hainan’s Measures to Support AI OPC Innovation and Development took effect June 20 — the first provincial-level OPC-specific support package, valid through end of 2028.
  • Capital: Changzhou released the “X-Claw Ten Rules” with a ¥100M special fund and up to ¥5M government direct equity for top projects; Wujiang (Suzhou) launched a ¥2B AI direct-investment fund and ¥10B dedicated credit line.
  • Org structure: Carta data — share of new companies founded by a single founder rose from 23.7% (2019) to 36.3% (H1 2025), a >50% jump in six years.
  • Evolution: The narrative is sliding from “one-person company” toward “no-human company” — MoltBook, a pure AI-Agent social network, pulled in 100K+ agents within 48 hours, an early shape of an autonomous AI public space.
  • Tooling: Moxin Tech launched SoloFounder OPC (7-step AI workflow); Bika.ai shipped an “AI Organizer for One-Person Company”; OpenClaw-class agent platforms are becoming the standard OPC base layer.

2. Policy Radar

In 2026, OPC support moved from “paper slogans” to “real cash,” forming three policy hubs plus several specialty nodes:

  • Shenzhen — Action Plan to Build an AI OPC Startup Ecosystem Leader (2026–2027): city-level vouchers up to ¥10M “training-compute voucher,” ¥2M “model voucher,” ¥2M “corpus voucher”; builds an “upstairs-is-upstream” industrial chain community.
  • Hainan — first provincial OPC policy (effective 6/20): dual 15% tax (15% corporate income tax, 15% capped personal income tax for high-end talent), “smart consumption vouchers” subsidizing compute/models, up to ¥10M unsecured credit loan + 1% interest discount, ≥200 rent-free workstations.
  • Suzhou / Wujiang — dedicated “Lobster Service Zone” deploys OpenClaw-class agents for free; ¥2B AI direct-investment fund, ¥10B dedicated credit, up to ¥1,500/month rent subsidy for 3 years; goal of 30+ OPC communities by 2028.
  • Changzhou / Wuxi / Shanghai — Changzhou opened 1,000 free cloud seats + ¥100M fund; Wuxi Hi-Tech Zone offers up to 3 years “zero rent”; Shanghai Xuhui offers up to ¥100K start funding + ¥1M compute/model voucher + free workspace & accounting.
  • Institutional base — from 2026-01-01, the revised Company Law removes the “one natural person = one OPC” limit; registered capital paid within 5 years; still limited liability; small-scale VAT taxpayers exempt below ¥100K monthly sales.

⚠️ Watch-out: Many “up to ¥8M rewards” are NOT paid directly to founders — they go to qualifying OPC communities (Hainan picks only 1–3 per year) and flow back via smart vouchers / rent-free seats. Read the fine print on who gets it and how.

3. Tools & Platforms

  • Moxin Tech SoloFounder OPC — 7-step AI workflow + AdAgent concept; positions itself as a “super-individual operating system” turning personal skills into a deployable business.
  • Bika.ai — “AI Organizer for One-Person Company”: AI Programmer (idea → webpage), X/Twitter Manager (auto-tweet), email automation templates.
  • OpenClaw / Lobster Service Zone — AI-native cloud platform; a solo dev completes full-stack dev, ops, and support with AI assistance; the “standard base” for many OPC communities.
  • Open-source solopreneur (GitHub / OpenRouter) — one key routes 200+ models (Claude, GPT, Gemini…) to build a collaborative AI-agent team, billed per token.
  • Solo Founders Program (SFP.club) — SF on-site accelerator, $100K investment + 3-month cohort; case Supermemory hit $2M ARR in 4 months solo, 25K GitHub stars.
  • Coze (扣子) — low-code multi-platform side-hustle system; non-coders can deploy content/customer-service agents.

4. Proof of Money (Real Cases)

  • Medvi (Texas, Matthew Gallagher) — $20K start, zero employees; by end of 2025: $401M revenue, 250K paying customers, 16.2% net margin (~$3M monthly net profit). One person ≈ a 100–200-person traditional e-commerce team.
  • Hangzhou 1-person company — AI-powered, ¥2M/month; per Tianxia Wangshang field visits, some OPC founders already earn ¥100K/month.
  • 17 AI Agents side hustle — one operator runs 17 agents at ¥50K/month via token consumption + multi-platform distribution.
  • Zero-human SaaS — AI agents run a ¥50K/month online SaaS with no manual intervention.
  • Qingdao music founder — AI cuts music demo production from a week to 5 minutes; projected annual revenue >¥1.5M.
  • UK virtual streamer — AI-generated singing + interactive content; 1M+ followers overseas; “one-person talent agency” model works.

5. Hot Tracks

  • AI Agent applications — composite score 9.9/10; keywords “automation, high compounding, low marginal cost”; vertical-scenario packaging is the core.
  • AI going overseas — better overseas payment habits, lighter competition; translate + localize a Chinese MVP to launch; some products 3x conversion lift.
  • Short-drama creation — one person finishes an 88-minute AI live-action mini-drama in 3 months at ~¥10K cost; production shifts from “heavy team” to “light individual.”
  • Virtual idol / audio creation — full-chain AI for modeling, voice synthesis, music; dubbing cost down to 1/1000 of traditional.
  • Vertical “shovel-selling” SaaS — go “one meter wide, one hundred meters deep”: hotpot inventory AI, primary-math tutoring AI, French-region customer-service AI.

6. Job Market & Salaries (2026)

AI-agent role salary bands (public postings, base only):

  • Prompt Engineer: junior ¥12–18K/mo, mid ¥18–28K, senior ¥28–45K
  • Agent Architect: junior ¥20–30K/mo, mid ¥30–50K, senior ¥50–90K
  • AI Product Manager: junior ¥16–25K/mo, mid ¥25–42K, senior ¥42–70K

7. Cold Truth & Risks

⚠️ Not every OPC makes money. Research shows profitable OPCs cluster in three types: ① executors who wire AI into real business flows; ② “expert” individuals in extremely vertical niches; ③ people who use AI to amplify their ability, not chase a fantasy “money printer.” AI is a lever, not a printer — it amplifies your strength and your blind spots.

  • Compute/Token is a hidden cost — running 17 agents racks up a real token bill; unit economics must be calculated.
  • Platform-dependency risk — multi-platform side hustles are directly exposed to platform audits, throttling, and rule changes.
  • “No-human company” compliance gap — purely agent-autonomous content/transactions remain a gray zone on liability, tax, and consumer rights.
